scenarios.name: Minimize and return from the taskbar

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the user selects Minimize in the application bar
the main window is minimized and its taskbar entry remains available
the user activates the application from the taskbar
the main window returns in the restored state
the same part and ribbon tab are active
the displayed part retains its view orientation
